dialogues.jp: リリン――
dialogues.en: Ring.
dialogues.text: Ring.

dialogues.jp: 鈴の音。
dialogues.en: The ring of a bell.
dialogues.text: The ring of a bell.

dialogues.jp: その音に導かれるように目が覚めた。
dialogues.en: The ringing of a bell woke me up.
dialogues.text: The ringing of a bell woke me up.

dialogues.jp:
意識がはっきりとしないが、お腹の上になにか
が乗っているのは分かった。
dialogues.en:
I noticed something was sitting on top of my stomach even
though I wasn't fully awake.
dialogues.text:
I noticed something was sitting on top of my stomach even
though I wasn't fully awake.

dialogues.jp: ちょうど人の頭くらいの重さ。
dialogues.en: It was as big as a human head.
dialogues.text: It was as big as a human head.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢っ！？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: 慌てて身体を起こす。
dialogues.en: I woke up in a hurry.
dialogues.text: I woke up in a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.jp: お腹に乗っていた白猫と目があう。
dialogues.en: The white cat sitting on my stomach looked at me in the eye.
dialogues.text: The white cat sitting on my stomach looked at me in the eye.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「さくら〜っ！！」
dialogues.en: "Sakura!!"
dialogues.text: "Sakura!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上で船をこいでいたさくらが、ゆっ
くりと顔を上げる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura was sleeping on top of the desk, and she looked up
slowly.
dialogues.text:
Sakura was sleeping on top of the desk, and she looked up
slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゃ……朝？」
dialogues.en: "Is it morning already?"
dialogues.text: "Is it morning already?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「朝って……朝か？」
dialogues.en: "Is it?"
dialogues.text: "Is it?"

dialogues.jp: 枕もとの時計は１１時。
dialogues.en: The alarm clock by my bed said 11 o'clock.
dialogues.text: The alarm clock by my bed said 11 o'clock.

dialogues.jp: よし、この時間でも春休み中はまだ朝だ。
dialogues.en: Okay. It could be considered as morning during spring break.
dialogues.text: Okay. It could be considered as morning during spring break.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん！　にゃ……お兄ちゃんグッモーニー
　ン♪」
dialogues.en: "Mm! Good morning, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Mm! Good morning, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「グッドって、俺は寝起きに宇宙の神秘を見せ
　られて心臓が止まるかと思ったんだが？」
dialogues.en: "How could it be good? Your weird cat scared me to death."
dialogues.text: "How could it be good? Your weird cat scared me to death."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うたまるのプリチーさに惚れちゃったんだ
　ね♪」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you love Utamaru."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you love Utamaru."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、絶対こいつおかしいって！」
dialogues.en: "No. I don't. She's so weird!"
dialogues.text: "No. I don't. She's so weird!"

dialogues.jp:
腹の上の謎の生命体――いや、生命体かどうか
もあやしい物体を示す。
dialogues.en:
I pointed at the unidentified lifeform on my stomach. I
don't even know if this thing's a lifeform.
dialogues.text:
I pointed at the unidentified lifeform on my stomach. I
don't even know if this thing's a lifeform.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ご主人様が首をかしげるのに合わせて、白猫も
首をかしげた。
dialogues.en: The white cat tilted her head as her master tilted her head.
dialogues.text: The white cat tilted her head as her master tilted her head.

dialogues.jp:
「今度、暦先生に情報をリークして解剖しても
　らうか、萌先輩に鍋にしてもらおう」
dialogues.en:
"I think we should tell Koyomi-sensei about this thing and
have her dissect it, or we should tell Moe-sempai and put it
in the hot pot."
dialogues.text:
"I think we should tell Koyomi-sensei about this thing and
have her dissect it, or we should tell Moe-sempai and put it
in the hot pot."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.jp:
首をかしげ続ける白猫を窓辺において、頭をか
きながらため息をつく。
dialogues.en:
I put the white cat by the window and sighed as I scratched
my head.
dialogues.text:
I put the white cat by the window and sighed as I scratched
my head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「どうしたの、なんか不機嫌さんだよ？　怖い
　夢でも見た？」
dialogues.en:
"What's wrong with you? You're in a bad mood. Did you have a
scary dream?"
dialogues.text:
"What's wrong with you? You're in a bad mood. Did you have a
scary dream?"

dialogues.jp: あれをなんと言えばいいのだろう。
dialogues.en: "Not scary...... but I had a few dreams."
dialogues.text: "Not scary...... but I had a few dreams."

dialogues.jp: 最初のは、さくらと俺のばあちゃんの夢だ。
dialogues.en: How should I describe it?
dialogues.text: How should I describe it?

dialogues.jp:
生粋のイギリス人なのに、和菓子と日本と、俺
達を愛してくれた人。
dialogues.en: The first dream was about Sakura and my grandmother.
dialogues.text: The first dream was about Sakura and my grandmother.

dialogues.jp:
仕事で忙しかった両親に代わり、面倒を見てく
れた、ばあちゃん。
dialogues.en:
My grandmother was an English woman, but she loved Japan,
Japanese sweets and us.
dialogues.text:
My grandmother was an English woman, but she loved Japan,
Japanese sweets and us.

dialogues.jp: やさしい夢。
dialogues.en: She took care of us when our parents were busy working.
dialogues.text: She took care of us when our parents were busy working.

dialogues.jp: ２番目は子供の頃の夢。
dialogues.en: It was a nice dream.
dialogues.text: It was a nice dream.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が妹になった夜の出来事。
dialogues.en: The second dream was about when I was a kid.
dialogues.text: The second dream was about when I was a kid.

dialogues.jp: 懐かしい夢。
dialogues.en: It was about the night Nemu became my little sister.
dialogues.text: It was about the night Nemu became my little sister.

dialogues.jp: ……最後の景色を思い出す。
dialogues.en: It seems so long ago.
dialogues.text: It seems so long ago.

dialogues.jp: 夕暮れの屋上。
dialogues.en: And I try to remember the last dream.
dialogues.text: And I try to remember the last dream.

dialogues.jp: あれは……。
dialogues.en: It was on the rooftop at dusk.
dialogues.text: It was on the rooftop at dusk.

dialogues.jp:
「あの音夢の着ていた服……本校の制服だった
　ような？」
dialogues.en: That is......
dialogues.text: That is......

dialogues.jp:
あんな、風まで感じるようなリアルな夢を見た
バカ者は誰だろう。
dialogues.en: "Nemu was wearing school uniform......"
dialogues.text: "Nemu was wearing school uniform......"

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、あのドラマの影響で――あ」
dialogues.en:
Who dreamed that dream... which was so real I could almost
feel the wind blowing?
dialogues.text:
Who dreamed that dream... which was so real I could almost
feel the wind blowing?

dialogues.jp: 思い出した。
dialogues.en: "Oh, that soap opera?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, that soap opera?"

dialogues.jp: キス。
dialogues.en: Kiss.
dialogues.text: Kiss.

dialogues.jp: キス、してしまったのか……。
dialogues.en: Have we kissed?
dialogues.text: Have we kissed?

dialogues.jp: 俺は自分の唇にそっと手を伸ばした。
dialogues.en: Would we have gone further if we hadn't passed out?
dialogues.text: Would we have gone further if we hadn't passed out?

dialogues.jp:
指先が触れるのは自分の唇で、そこに感じる体
温は俺のものでしかない。
dialogues.en: Doing this and that as she called me niisan...
dialogues.text: Doing this and that as she called me niisan...

dialogues.jp:
俺のものでしかないとわかっているけど、今も
そこに音夢のぬくもりがあるような、そんな気
がして……。
dialogues.en: "Wait, wait! Sakura! Where's Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Wait, wait! Sakura! Where's Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: 「……って、そうだよ！」
dialogues.en: I stood in front of Sakura as I shook my head.
dialogues.text: I stood in front of Sakura as I shook my head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの、お兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "She's sleeping."
dialogues.text: "She's sleeping."

dialogues.jp: 頭を振って立ち上がり、さくらの前に立つ。
dialogues.en: "Okay...... Wait a minute."
dialogues.text: "Okay...... Wait a minute."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、いつの間に部屋に帰ってきたの
か？
dialogues.en: When did I come back to my own room?
dialogues.text: When did I come back to my own room?

dialogues.jp: それに、服も制服からパジャマになってるし。
dialogues.en:
And my clothes have been changed into pajamas from school
uniform.
dialogues.text:
And my clothes have been changed into pajamas from school
uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「……まさか」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god......"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god......"

dialogues.jp: また唇に触れる。
dialogues.en: I touched my lip.
dialogues.text: I touched my lip.

dialogues.jp:
音夢との仲直りと……その……キスまでも夢だっ
たのではないのか？
dialogues.en: Was I dreaming about making up with Nemu and kissing her?
dialogues.text: Was I dreaming about making up with Nemu and kissing her?

dialogues.jp:
けれど、レモンの味ではなかったが、歴史的瞬
間の感触はきっちり覚えていた。
dialogues.en:
But I remembered the feeling of the historic moment,
although it wasn't what I expected from a first kiss.
dialogues.text:
But I remembered the feeling of the historic moment,
although it wasn't what I expected from a first kiss.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうしたってんでい兄貴？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What happened?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……これも夢じゃないよな？」
dialogues.en: "Is this a dream?"
dialogues.text: "Is this a dream?"

dialogues.jp: 頬をつねってみる。
dialogues.en: I pinched her cheek.
dialogues.text: I pinched her cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いにゃにゃにゃにゃ！！」
dialogues.en: "Ouch!"
dialogues.text: "Ouch!"

dialogues.jp: 痛い……らしい。
dialogues.en: It hurts her.
dialogues.text: It hurts her.

dialogues.jp:
「そうか現実か。しかし、ぷにゃぷにゃなほっ
　ぺただな」
dialogues.en:
"So this is for real. But, look at your cheek. It's so
soft."
dialogues.text:
"So this is for real. But, look at your cheek. It's so
soft."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いたた……顔が伸びちゃうよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Ouch...... You're stretching my skin."
dialogues.text: "Ouch...... You're stretching my skin."

dialogues.jp:
俺から逃げ出そうとして、でも足元にへばりつ
いてさくらが頬をさする。
dialogues.en: Sakura rubbed her cheeks trying to run away from me.
dialogues.text: Sakura rubbed her cheeks trying to run away from me.

dialogues.jp: 「子猫みたいな奴だな」
dialogues.en: "You're just like a cat."
dialogues.text: "You're just like a cat."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ほっぺたつねるなら、自分のをつねりなよぉ」
dialogues.en: "You should pinch your own cheek......"
dialogues.text: "You should pinch your own cheek......"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「自分のは痛いだろうが。そんなに痛かった
　か？」
dialogues.en: "It would hurt me then. Did it hurt that much?"
dialogues.text: "It would hurt me then. Did it hurt that much?"

dialogues.jp:
思いのほか力がはいってしまっていたのか。女
の子の顔とあってさすがに心配になる。
dialogues.en:
Maybe I pinched her too hard. I shouldn't be so harsh on a
girl.
dialogues.text:
Maybe I pinched her too hard. I shouldn't be so harsh on a
girl.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「痛かったよぉ〜、すごく痛かったからさすっ
　てお兄ちゃん。チューでもいいよ♪」
dialogues.en:
"It hurt me. Here, make it better by rubbing it or you can
kiss it."
dialogues.text:
"It hurt me. Here, make it better by rubbing it or you can
kiss it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "A kiss?"
dialogues.text: "A kiss?"

dialogues.jp: あぁ、そうキスだよな……キス。
dialogues.en: Oh, yeah. A kiss.
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah. A kiss.

dialogues.jp: 妹と、キス……。
dialogues.en: I kissed my little sister on the lips.
dialogues.text: I kissed my little sister on the lips.

dialogues.jp: まさか奪われるとは……いやはや。
dialogues.en: I thought it would never happen.
dialogues.text: I thought it would never happen.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃん……さっきからなんで上の空にな
　るの？」
dialogues.en: But I didn't expect her to kiss me.
dialogues.text: But I didn't expect her to kiss me.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あっ！　それより、いったい何がどうなって
　俺はベッドで寝てたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Oniichan...... Why are you spacing out like that?"
dialogues.text: "Oniichan...... Why are you spacing out like that?"

dialogues.jp: どうにも、さくらと話をしてると脱線が多い。
dialogues.en: "Hey, by the way, how did I end up on the bed sleeping?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, by the way, how did I end up on the bed sleeping?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それよりって……ぶぅ。音夢ちゃんもお兄ちゃ
　んも、下で倒れてたのをボクが運んであげた
　のに」
dialogues.en:
The conversation goes all over the place when I talk to
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
The conversation goes all over the place when I talk to
Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「運んだ？　お前がひとりで？」
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean by the way? I carried you and Nemu-chan
from downstairs since you were both knocked out."
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean by the way? I carried you and Nemu-chan
from downstairs since you were both knocked out."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。こう、足をかかえてがんばって運んだ
　んだよ。偉いでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Uh-huh. I pulled you by the legs like this. Aren't I
great?"
dialogues.text:
"Uh-huh. I pulled you by the legs like this. Aren't I
great?"

dialogues.jp: こいつも怪力なのか……そんなんばっかやな。
dialogues.en: How could she have a power like that?
dialogues.text: How could she have a power like that?

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、ちょうど昨日の夜に家に来たんだな。
　そっか、助かったサンキュな」
dialogues.en: "So you came over last night? Thanks for the help."
dialogues.text: "So you came over last night? Thanks for the help."

dialogues.jp:
窓も修理しなかった甲斐があったってもんだ。
面倒くさがりさまさまだな。
dialogues.en:
So I shouldn't have fixed the window after all. It pays to
be a lazy bum.
dialogues.text:
So I shouldn't have fixed the window after all. It pays to
be a lazy bum.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちなみに、もう一昨日の夜だよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, by the way, it's the day before yesterday."
dialogues.text: "Oh, by the way, it's the day before yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の様子でも確かめに行こうとして、思わず
動きを止める。
dialogues.en: I stopped as I was about to go check on Nemu.
dialogues.text: I stopped as I was about to go check on Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それ、一昨日の話。今日は１７日のハッピー
　サンデー♪」
dialogues.en:
"You're talking about the day before yesterday. Today's the
17th. Happy Sunday."
dialogues.text:
"You're talking about the day before yesterday. Today's the
17th. Happy Sunday."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「え？　冗談？」
dialogues.en: "You're kidding me."
dialogues.text: "You're kidding me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こんなのブラックジョークにもならないよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not even a joke."
dialogues.text: "It's not even a joke."

dialogues.jp: さくらが肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: Sakura shrugged her shoulders.
dialogues.text: Sakura shrugged her shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、本当に俺は丸１日以上ぶっつづけで
　倒れてたのか……」
dialogues.en: "So I really slept through more than a day?"
dialogues.text: "So I really slept through more than a day?"

dialogues.jp: 信じられない。
dialogues.en: I can't believe it.
dialogues.text: I can't believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよ。ボクがずっと看病してたんだから」
dialogues.en: "That's right. I've been here to take care of you guys."
dialogues.text: "That's right. I've been here to take care of you guys."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、だってさ」
dialogues.en: "......Oh my god."
dialogues.text: "......Oh my god."

dialogues.jp:
心身ともに絶好調だった俺が倒れるなんて、まっ
たく信じられない。
dialogues.en:
I can't believe I passed out like that. I've been as healthy
as I could be.
dialogues.text:
I can't believe I passed out like that. I've been as healthy
as I could be.

dialogues.jp: ガスでも漏れていたのか？
dialogues.en: Was it caused by a gas leak?
dialogues.text: Was it caused by a gas leak?

dialogues.jp:
まさか、最近なんだか胸の調子がおかしかった
が、キスの衝撃がとどめになったとか？
dialogues.en:
Or was it because of the shock from the kiss, since my heart
has been acting irregularly?
dialogues.text:
Or was it because of the shock from the kiss, since my heart
has been acting irregularly?

dialogues.jp: 「まてよ……」
その時、恐ろしい事実に気が付く。
dialogues.en: I noticed something at that moment.
dialogues.text: I noticed something at that moment.

dialogues.jp: 「まさか――」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god......"
dialogues.text: "Oh my god......"

dialogues.jp:
「まさか、俺の服を着替えさせたのはお前
　か！？」
dialogues.en: "Did you change my clothes?"
dialogues.text: "Did you change my clothes?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん。下着も替えてあげたよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I even changed your underwear."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I even changed your underwear."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぶっ――見たんかいッ！？」
dialogues.en: "What! Did you see it?"
dialogues.text: "What! Did you see it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そんな照れなくたっていいって。子供のころ、
　お医者さんごっこした仲良しさんだもん♪」
dialogues.en: "Don't be shy. We played doctors when we were kids."
dialogues.text: "Don't be shy. We played doctors when we were kids."

dialogues.jp: さくらが無邪気に手を振る。
dialogues.en: Sakura waved her hands innocently.
dialogues.text: Sakura waved her hands innocently.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、あの頃とは色々違うだろ……」
dialogues.en: "But the size is different than before......"
dialogues.text: "But the size is different than before......"

dialogues.jp: 嫌な汗がだらだら、と流れる。
dialogues.en: I started to sweat.
dialogues.text: I started to sweat.

dialogues.jp: 「うぅ……やっぱり調子悪いのかも知れん」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... Maybe I do feel bad after all."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... Maybe I do feel bad after all."

dialogues.jp:
俺は気を取り直して、音夢のことを聞くことに
した。
dialogues.en: "I didn't know they become hard and large."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know they become hard and large."

dialogues.jp: 「……で、音夢はまだ倒れてるのか……」
dialogues.en: "Forget it...... Where's Nemu? Is she still sleeping?"
dialogues.text: "Forget it...... Where's Nemu? Is she still sleeping?"

dialogues.jp: 胸を押さえたまま、さくらを真面目に見つめる。
dialogues.en: I held my chest and looked at Sakura seriously.
dialogues.text: I held my chest and looked at Sakura seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「う……うん。多分、お兄ちゃんより深く寝て
　ると思う」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... I guess her sleep's deeper than yours."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... I guess her sleep's deeper than yours."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それでねお兄ちゃん。音夢ちゃんの面倒はボ
　クが看ようと思うんだ……だから泊めてくれ
　ないかなぁ？」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking about taking care of Nemu-chan myself. Can I
stay for a while?"
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking about taking care of Nemu-chan myself. Can I
stay for a while?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、いいよそんなこと。それに音夢は病院
　に連れて行かないと」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry about that. I have to take Nemu to the
hospital."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry about that. I have to take Nemu to the
hospital."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もうお医者さんには診せたの。お兄ちゃんも
　診てもらってるんだよ。それでね、原因は分
　からないけど、安静にしておけって」
dialogues.en:
"I already called the doctor. You've been checked by the
doctor as well. The doctor couldn't tell what caused it, but
he said you guys need to rest."
dialogues.text:
"I already called the doctor. You've been checked by the
doctor as well. The doctor couldn't tell what caused it, but
he said you guys need to rest."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それにそれに、音夢ちゃん女の子だから、き
　れいにしておいてあげたいでしょ？　ね？」
dialogues.en:
"Haven't you wanted to take care of Nemu properly since she
was a girl?"
dialogues.text:
"Haven't you wanted to take care of Nemu properly since she
was a girl?"

dialogues.jp: さくらも真剣な面持ちで俺を見上げる。
dialogues.en: Sakura looked up at me seriously as well.
dialogues.text: Sakura looked up at me seriously as well.

dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん」
そうだなぁ。
dialogues.en: I guess.
dialogues.text: I guess.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、今の精神状態で眠っている音夢の面倒
を看るっていうのは危険な気がするし……。
dialogues.en:
It may be too much for me to take care of Nemu, since I'm
feeling a little confused at the moment.
dialogues.text:
It may be too much for me to take care of Nemu, since I'm
feeling a little confused at the moment.

dialogues.jp: 「悪い。それじゃあ面倒だが頼むわ」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Would you take care of Nemu for me then?"
dialogues.text: "Okay. Would you take care of Nemu for me then?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ドント・ウォーリー！　そんな心配しないで
　お兄ちゃん。さくらにお任せっ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry! I'll take good care of her."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry! I'll take good care of her."

dialogues.jp:
くるり、と魔法少女みたいにその場で回ってさ
くらが笑う。
dialogues.en: Sakura turned around and smiled.
dialogues.text: Sakura turned around and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ほらっ、お兄ちゃんも、もうちょっと寝てな
　さいって！」
dialogues.en: "Well then. You need to go back to sleep."
dialogues.text: "Well then. You need to go back to sleep."

dialogues.jp:
ぽすっ、とさくらが抱きついてきて、そのまま
頭でベッドまで押される。
dialogues.en:
Sakura hugged me and she pushed me towards the bed with her
head against me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura hugged me and she pushed me towards the bed with her
head against me.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、いや俺は大丈夫だって」
dialogues.en: "Hey, I'm fine now."
dialogues.text: "Hey, I'm fine now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫だって言ってて倒れたんでしょうが。
　お姉ちゃんの言うことが聞けないの？」
dialogues.en:
"You were knocked out saying that you were fine. You better
listen to me."
dialogues.text:
"You were knocked out saying that you were fine. You better
listen to me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「こんな時だけお姉ちゃんぶられてもなぁ」
dialogues.en: "You're acting like my big sister now."
dialogues.text: "You're acting like my big sister now."

dialogues.jp: 思わず笑ってしまう。
dialogues.en: She made me laugh.
dialogues.text: She made me laugh.

dialogues.jp:
本当ならさくらの力でなんて押されないのだが、
どうにも足が後ろに下がる。
dialogues.en:
I stepped backward letting her push me, even though she
isn't strong enough to do so herself.
dialogues.text:
I stepped backward letting her push me, even though she
isn't strong enough to do so herself.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はい♪　これでお休みできるよ、っと！」
dialogues.en: "Okay. You can rest now."
dialogues.text: "Okay. You can rest now."

dialogues.jp:
ぼふっ、とベッドに座り込んだところにシーツ
をかぶせられる。
dialogues.en: She tucked me in after I sat on the bed.
dialogues.text: She tucked me in after I sat on the bed.

dialogues.jp: 「はいはい、分かったよ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, fine."
dialogues.text: "Okay, fine."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「かったるいから任せた〜、俺は寝る〜、とか
　言えるくらいまで元気にならないと♪」
dialogues.en:
"You should rest until you're able to say 'Sakura, you need
to sleep more.'"
dialogues.text:
"You should rest until you're able to say 'Sakura, you need
to sleep more.'"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それは元気というかなんと言うか……」
dialogues.en: "That's not how I am......"
dialogues.text: "That's not how I am......"

dialogues.jp: シーツを頭からはがして、さくらを見上げる。
dialogues.en: I looked up at Sakura sliding the sheets off of my head.
dialogues.text: I looked up at Sakura sliding the sheets off of my head.

dialogues.jp:
「なぁ……一目だけ音夢を見にいっちゃいけな
　いか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey...... Can I go see Nemu just a little bit?"
dialogues.text: "Hey...... Can I go see Nemu just a little bit?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「駄目！　今は静かに眠ること」
dialogues.en: "No! You need to rest now."
dialogues.text: "No! You need to rest now."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんが起きるころには、美味しいご飯
　を用意しておいてあげるから、みんなで食べ
　よ♪」
dialogues.en:
"Next time you wake up, we'll all have a good meal together,
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Next time you wake up, we'll all have a good meal together,
okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「子守唄はいる？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to sing you a lullaby?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to sing you a lullaby?"

dialogues.jp:
くすくす、とさくらが外見に似合わない静かな
笑みを浮かべた。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiled quietly which was so unlike her.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiled quietly which was so unlike her.

dialogues.jp: 「いいから音夢を看てやってくれ」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine, but would you go see Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "I'm fine, but would you go see Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん……おやすみ。今度はいい夢見れるよ」
dialogues.en: "Fine...... Good night. You have a better dream this time."
dialogues.text: "Fine...... Good night. You have a better dream this time."

dialogues.jp: 扉に手をかけて、さくらが小さく首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: Sakura tilted her head as she was walking out the door.
dialogues.text: Sakura tilted her head as she was walking out the door.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: ――パタン
dialogues.en: The door closed.
dialogues.text: The door closed.

dialogues.jp: 部屋が静かになる。
dialogues.en: The room became silent.
dialogues.text: The room became silent.

dialogues.jp:
しばらくぼ〜っとしていたが、布団の中にもぐ
りこんで目を閉じる。
dialogues.en:
I stared into space for a while, but I covered myself and
closed my eyes.
dialogues.text:
I stared into space for a while, but I covered myself and
closed my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
春の日の布団の中は暖かくて、広くて……少し
寂しい。
dialogues.en: The inside of bed was warm and roomy and a little bit sad.
dialogues.text: The inside of bed was warm and roomy and a little bit sad.

dialogues.jp: ◆忍び寄る病◆
dialogues.en: ◆Stalked by an illness◆
dialogues.text: ◆Stalked by an illness◆

dialogues.jp:
目が覚めるとさくらとコケシ猫が俺の看病をし
ていた。どうやら意識を失ってから、丸１日以
上ぶっつづけで眠っていたらしい。
dialogues.en:
I found the weird cat taking care of me when I woke up. I'd
been sleeping for more than a day since I lost
consciousness.
dialogues.text:
I found the weird cat taking care of me when I woke up. I'd
been sleeping for more than a day since I lost
consciousness.

dialogues.jp:
いまも眠っているという音夢の看病をさくらに
任せ、俺は再び眠りについた。
dialogues.en:
I asked Sakura to take care of Nemu who was still sleeping
and I went back to sleep again.
dialogues.text:
I asked Sakura to take care of Nemu who was still sleeping
and I went back to sleep again.
